title: Regional fuse profile and safe fail-switch for dependency/model/tenant paths
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement a configurable 'regional fuse' and deterministic fail-switch that: (1) applies circuit-breaking at the dependency/model/tenant granularity, (2) exposes configurable trip curves (error rate, p99 latency, queue growth, token drop), and (3) executes safe fallback actions (model variant swap, regional reroute, partial shed) with automatic recovery/hysteresis. The goal is to maintain SLOs for paying tiers while avoiding system-wide cascades during regional spikes or dependency degradation. This ticket covers spec, runtime changes, config surface, metrics/alerts, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Circuit rules can be defined per-tenant, per-model, and per-dependency via service config and loaded dynamically
Trip decision uses a weighted signal combining error-rate (5xx), p99 latency, and queue depth with EWMA smoothing
Fallback actions support: model-variant swap, regional reroute, and incremental shed with an execution policy ordered by safety/cost
Hysteresis windows and cooldowns prevent flapping and support graceful recovery
Telemetry: every trip records cause vectors, affected requests, SLO delta, and a Runbook link; dashboards and alerts created
Canary rollout (staging -> alpha tenants -> 10% traffic -> 100%) with rollback hooks and automated observability checks
tasks: Spec: define trip curve math, signal weights, and default profiles for 'hosted', 'dedicated', and 'private' tiers
Runtime: extend breaker service to accept per-key profiles and evaluate EWMA-based thresholds
Fallback executor: implement safe action sequencer (variant->region->shed) with rate-limited traffic shift
Config: Console UI + API for editing regional fuse profiles and tenant overrides
Telemetry: add trip-event schema, dashboard panels, and SLO impact metric exports
Tests: chaos simulation, multi-region load tests, and tenant isolation regressions
Docs/Runbook: operational playbook and rollback steps
design_decisions: Use composite trip score = 0.6*error_rate_normalized + 0.3*p99_latency_normalized + 0.1*queue_growth_normalized to balance correctness vs latency
Use EWMA with 60s alpha for fast spikes and 10m window for stable hysteresis (two-tier smoothing)
Fallback order: (1) model-variant quantized/low-CPU variant, (2) regional reroute to warm standby, (3) incremental request shedding by tenant priority
Per-tenant overrides allowed but bounded by guardrails in the platform to prevent unsafe configs
Metric normalization based on baseline percentiles per-region to avoid unfair trips during region-wide latency shifts
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: aggressive variant swap may degrade answer quality. Mitigation: quality delta must be computed via promptset evals; only apply variant swap when expected quality loss < configured threshold

Risk: traffic storms during regional reroute saturate standby region. Mitigation: rate-limit reroute and warm standby pool proportionally; use circuit to back off reroute if downstream usage exceeds headroom
Risk: tenant-level configs accidentally escalate cost. Mitigation: Console warns and requires approval for overrides that increase peak throughput or cross-region egress

2026-03-13 Load test results: staging 10k RPS with injected 5xx spike — composite score tripped after 18s and executed model-variant swap; p99 recovered from 1.2s -> 350ms within 40s. Quality regression measured at 1.1% for targeted prompts (within threshold).
